game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel, a frosted chapel: the sled courier must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against snow wraiths.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel: a frosted chapel
core_gameplay_loop: In Frosted Chapel, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against snow wraiths. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the spells value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about spells to power up the sled courier and open the sleigh.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Frosted Chapel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Frosted Chapel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
